services.name: Giant Bluefin Tuna Charters
services.desc: Join us for this bucket list trip catching the hardest fighting fish in the ocean! 8 hours About Come and join us for a thrilling fishing charter where you can reel in a giant bluefin tuna. We bring 25 years of experience and are centrally located to all of the best fishing grounds in the area. We'll teach you how to get on the fish and will put 110% of effort into getting you your giant bluefin tuna. These charters are for first time family's wanting to try and land a giant to big game anglers looking for a big catch. Test yourself against the ocean's toughest game For all ages! • 8 Hours • Max of 6 Anglers
